data.one_liner: Utilities for running Dart code correctly on the Google Cloud Platform.
data.what_it_does: Provides core utilities for Google Cloud Platform integration in Dart, including automatic project ID discovery via environment variables, configuration, and metadata server, as well as metadata API access.
use_when: You are running a Dart application on Google Cloud Platform and need to discover the current project ID.
You need to access the Google Cloud Metadata Server from within a running Dart service.
avoid_when: You are building a client application unrelated to Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
You need logging or HTTP serving features (which have been split into separate packages like google_cloud_logging and google_cloud_shelf).
strengths: Automatic project discovery using multiple fallback strategies.
Built-in caching for metadata server responses.
weaknesses: Community-supported project with no official SLA or deprecation policy.
Recent breaking changes have spun off logging and HTTP serving into separate packages.
data.setup_notes: Requires appropriate Google Cloud environment variables or credentials depending on your deployment environment.
